name: Hotel Klima
beschreibung: The Hotel Klima is located in Neustift im Stubaital, a municipality in the Stubai-Tirol holiday region. The surroundings are dominated by the Stubaier Alpen, with the Stubaier Gletscher as the central ski area in winter. In the summer months, the valley is a starting point for hikes to the Elferkogel and via ferrata routes in the region. The hotel offers a quiet, family-friendly atmosphere and has a wellness area with sauna and relaxation room. The rooms are modernly furnished, many with a balcony and view of the surrounding mountain world. In the hotel's own restaurant, a breakfast buffet as well as dinner with regional dishes are offered. For guests, parking spaces and storage facilities for ski equipment are available. The accommodation is suitable for vacationers who want to spend an active ski vacation or a relaxed hiking week in the Alps.
